fr_html: Si les membres du Comité se trouvent vraiment d'accord sur le fond du problème, la tâche se réduit à trouver une formule qui exprime cet accord: cette tâche est relativement facile. Mais M. Hagerup croit que, sur le point actuel, cet accord n'existe pas. Voici, pour sa part, comment il a compris le discours prononcé la veille par Mr. Root, et son impression a été confirmée par une conversation qu'il a eue avec Mr. Root lui-même.
en_html: If the members of the Committee were really agreed upon the heart of the question, their task was reduced to finding an expression of their agreement. This task was comparatively easy. But M. Hagerup thought that they were not agreed upon the point under discussion. That was the impression he had drawn from Mr. Root's speech on the preceding day, and his impression had been confirmed by conversations which he had had with Mr. Root himself.
